title: Art. 3.33.4 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 3 - Entry and Departure of Persons and Their Baggage, H. Inspection of travel documents, 3.33.4
content: Recommended Practice. Each Contracting State should consider the introduction of Automated Border Control (ABC) systems in order to facilitate and expedite the clearance of persons entering or departing by air.
